method: Actual local-model relation component controls; candidate lookup alone is fixed.

suite.method: Frozen before the first actual v4 relation call. Allowed kinds distinguish unsafe contradictions from legitimate optional topical links. Component test uses production infer with real Ollama; only candidate lookup is fixed, not an end-to-end discovery or Wiki summarization result.

cases.origin: This note describes Indigo backup schedules. It makes no statement about Indigo's memory limit.
cases.target: Indigo has a memory limit of 64 megabytes.
cases.origin_summary: No memory limit is recorded in this note.
cases.target_summary: Indigo has a 64 megabyte memory limit.

cases.origin: Maple permits exports on Fridays. This rule does not apply during inspections, when exports are prohibited.
cases.target: During inspections, Maple prohibits exports on Fridays.
cases.target_summary: Maple prohibits Friday exports during inspections.

cases.origin: Saffron has a capacity of 41 litres.

actual.reason: The origin text states that Maple permits exports on Fridays, but the target text explicitly states that during inspections, Maple prohibits exports on Fridays. These are mutually incompatible assertions regarding the same subject (Maple exports) and condition (Fridays), as the origin text clarifies its rule does not apply during inspections.
